Sub_1_Range_Payload.name: Trans-Oceanic Global Range & Payload Envelopes
Sub_1_Range_Payload.description: Quantifies non-stop mission radius with NBAA IFR fuel reserves, payload-range trade-off curve, and ETOPS 330/370-minute routing authority.
Sub_1_Range_Payload.nitpick: Extreme fuel capacity adds massive structural weight; solved by carbon-composite airframe analysis.

Sub_2_Cabin_Ergonomics.name: Cabin Atmospheric Health, Ergonomics & VVIP Bespoke Tailoring
Sub_2_Cabin_Ergonomics.description: Measures cabin pressurization altitude at FL450/FL510, fresh air replacement cycle time, acoustic isolation (dBA), master stateroom/shower suites, and circadian lighting.
Sub_2_Cabin_Ergonomics.nitpick: Widebody flying palaces create psychological fatigue without compartmentalized acoustic zones; solved by multi-zone architectural partitions.

Sub_3_Propulsion_Mach.name: Propulsion Singularity, Mach Velocity & Cruise Thermodynamics
Sub_3_Propulsion_Mach.description: Evaluates cruise velocity (Mach 0.94 sprint down to 330 kt turboprop cruise), thermodynamic bypass ratio, specific fuel consumption (SFC), and time-to-climb to clean air.
Sub_3_Propulsion_Mach.nitpick: Higher Mach numbers dramatically accelerate fuel burn; solved by laminar-flow wing profile optimization.

Sub_4_Airfield_Agility.name: Airfield Agility, Runway Viscosity & Steep Approach Access
Sub_4_Airfield_Agility.description: Quantifies balanced field length (takeoff distance), high-altitude hot-and-high airfield performance, unimproved grass/gravel strip landing certification, and London City / Aspen steep approach (5.5° glideslope).
Sub_4_Airfield_Agility.nitpick: Jumbo jets are restricted to Class-A international hubs; solved by balancing widebody flagships with PC-24/PC-12 airfield penetrators.

Sub_5_Avionics_Safety.name: Avionics Purity, Safety Envelope & Autonomy
Sub_5_Avionics_Safety.description: Evaluates fly-by-wire active control sidesticks, synthetic vision systems (SVS), enhanced vision systems (EVS/HUD), envelope protection, and Garmin Emergency Autoland autonomy.
Sub_5_Avionics_Safety.nitpick: Complex automated avionics can induce pilot complacency; solved by intuitive tactile force-feedback sidesticks.

Sub_6_Operating_Viscosity.name: Operating Viscosity, Direct Operating Cost (DOC) & 10-Yr Residual Capital Preservation
Sub_6_Operating_Viscosity.description: Direct Operating Cost per flight hour (DOC $/hr), maintenance reserve programs (Rolls-Royce CorporateCare, Pratt & Whitney ESP), charter hourly yield, and HJB viscosity floor: P_ruin = 0.000000%.
Sub_6_Operating_Viscosity.nitpick: VVIP widebody jumbo jets incur immense standing hangar and crew costs; solved by charter fleet offsetting and asset utilization analysis.

Sub_7_Inductive_Conditioning.name: Inductive Sequential Conditioning & Adversarial Nitpicking
Sub_7_Inductive_Conditioning.description: Recursive conditioning: Aircraft #k explicitly diagnoses the runway restrictions, massive DOC, or spartan range of Aircraft #(k-1), addressing a distinct mission envelope while setting boundary constraints for Aircraft #(k+1).
Sub_7_Inductive_Conditioning.nitpick: Preventing homogenous lists of identical business jets; solved by spanning widebody palaces, trans-oceanic speedsters, and STOL backcountry connectors.
